name: gitflux
description: See what your coding agent does to git and GitHub, live. Opens a local page with a branch map, plain-English activity and danger alerts, and stops git commands that would lose work until you say yes.

interface.shortDescription: See what your agent does to git
interface.longDescription: GitFlux starts with each Codex session and opens a live map of your project's git history: what's saved on your laptop, what's on GitHub, every change in plain English, and alerts for the moments that lose work. Before Codex runs a git command that would erase work, GitFlux stops it and Codex asks you first.
